csd.why: the repository ships no CSD or IDCAMS DEFINE for EPSMORTF; EPSMLIST browses it by RBA (STARTBR ... RBA, which IBM allows only on an ESDS or a KSDS base) and reads it INTO MORTGAGE-COMPANY-INFO (COPY EPSMORTF), 56 bytes: an ESDS of fixed 56-byte records, the four companies in arrival order

scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: A805 runs its SELECT FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 (SQLCODE 0, MSGERRO untouched); LOW-VALUES into EPMENUO, SEND MAP EPMENU ERASE CURSOR; PROCESS-INDICATOR '3'; RETURN TRANSID('EPSP') with the 106-byte COMMAREA

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: the map is cleared and sent again with ERASE; the COMMAREA goes back as received

scenarios.name: pf3-at-menu
scenarios.why: PF3 with PROCESS-INDICATOR '3': SEND TEXT 'END OF TRANSACTION - THANK YOU' ERASE FREEKB, then a plain RETURN (no TRANSID)

scenarios.name: pf12-at-menu
scenarios.why: PF12 is the same WHEN as PF3 (DFHPF3 OR DFHPF12)

scenarios.name: pf3-from-list
scenarios.why: PF3 with PROCESS-INDICATOR '9' (back from the company list): SEND TEXT of one blank ERASE FREEKB, SEND MAP FROM(EPMENUO) with no ERASE/DATAONLY (SEND-ALL), indicator back to '3', RETURN TRANSID

scenarios.name: other-key-from-list
scenarios.why: WHEN OTHER with indicator '9': nothing to calculate; RETURN TRANSID('EPSP') with the COMMAREA unchanged

scenarios.name: pf9-list
scenarios.why: PF9: PROCESS-INDICATOR '9', LINK EPSMLIST with the COMMAREA: it browses the ESDS EPSMORTF by RBA from RBA 0 to ENDFILE (no company has a rate below 3.500, so no LINK to EPSCSMRT), sends map EPSMLIS and RETURNs; then RETURN TRANSID('EPSP') with the COMMAREA

scenarios.name: enter-from-list
scenarios.why: ENTER with indicator '9' (the list on screen): LINK EPSMLIST again, the same browse; RETURN TRANSID

scenarios.name: enter-principal-zero
scenarios.why: ENTER with indicator '3': A100 RECEIVEs map EPMENU, CALLs EPSNBRVL three times (principal, years, rate), A600 LINKs EPSCSMRT which CALLs EPSMPMT: principal 0 is not > 0, error 1, RETCODE 8; the float formula is never reached

scenarios.name: enter-principal-blank
scenarios.why: a blank principal: EPSNBRVL's error 1 (nothing but spaces), number 0, so EPSMPMT's error 1 again

scenarios.name: enter-principal-only-points
scenarios.why: a principal of two decimal points and no digits: EPSNBRVL's error 3 (a second decimal point), number 0, EPSMPMT's error 1 (a principal such as '1.2.3' keeps its digits and would reach the payment formula: not a scenario)

scenarios.name: enter-principal-too-large
scenarios.why: principal 100000000.50 is over EPSMPMT's maximum 100000000.01: error 2, RETCODE 8

scenarios.name: enter-rate-zero
scenarios.why: a zero rate (EPSMPMT's error 3), valid principal: validation fails before the annuity formula

scenarios.name: other-key-calc-principal-zero
scenarios.why: not ENTER, not PF3/PF9/PF12/CLEAR, indicator '3': WHEN OTHER runs A600 straight on the COMMAREA (no RECEIVE): EPSCSMRT / EPSMPMT error 1

scenarios.name: other-key-calc-rate-zero
scenarios.why: WHEN OTHER with a zero rate in the COMMAREA: EPSMPMT's error 3

scenarios.name: first-entry-dummy-select-fails
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0 with A805's SELECT IBMREQD FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 failing (SQLCODE -913): IF SQLCODE = 100 is false, SQLCODE NOT = 0 is true, so SQL-ERROR-CODE gets 913 and MSGERRO the SQL-ERROR-MSG text; the map is still sent

notes: IBM DBB MortgageApplication's mortgage screen (transaction EPSP, map EPMENU of mapset EPSMORT, whose symbolic map the repository does not ship: generated from epsmort.bms, `@bms/`). Every task first runs A805's dummy SELECT IBMREQD FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 (Db2's own one-row table: no DDL, no seed). The COMMAREA is DFHCOMMAREA (COPY EPSMTCOM: PROCESS-INDICATOR, the EPSMTINP inputs, the EPSMTOUT outputs), 106 bytes. ENTER with indicator '3' (A100: RECEIVE MAP, three CALLs of EPSNBRVL, then A600's LINK to EPSCSMRT, which CALLs EPSMPMT; both CALLed programs are `subprograms`, det-translated, #4803) and WHEN OTHER with '3' (A600) run through their VALIDATION paths only (principal not > 0 or over the maximum, rate not > 0, and EPSNBRVL's three error texts): EPSMPMT returns before its payment formula in these scenarios (the payment is a scenario of mortgage-csmrt and mortgage-mpmt, whose `**` is IEEE binary64, oracle_assumptions.md C6; its CBL NUMPROC(MIG) is modelled since #4271, C5). first-entry-dummy-select-fails injects SQLCODE -913 on A805's SELECT (#6072). A300-SEND-MAP's WHEN SEND-MAPONLY and no-WHEN arms are stated infeasible (tests/equivalence/infeasible_outcomes/mortgage-cmort.json). EPSMPMT has no holes since #6831 and #6844 (owner-stated binary64, #5867), so the callee-holes rule (#4803, mainframe-evidence-policy.md 4) no longer holds the port back. A company EPSMLIST lists (PF9, ENTER from the list) LINKs EPSCSMRT too, so the list scenarios quote a rate no company is below. PF9 and ENTER from the list run EPSMLIST in the same task (`programs`), which browses the ESDS EPSMORTF by RBA (#4213): the dataset is stated by the case (`csd`), as in mortgage-mlist.
